AttemptIn.description: `POST /api/attempts`: one round answered, sent once the round is over (or left).
AttemptIn.title: AttemptIn

Config.description: A session's settings, snapshotted when it starts (§15 "consent/config snapshot"), so a replay uses the same.
Config.title: Config

Event.description:
An attempt as the log keeps it: what the database holds and what an export carries, so a replay from either
goes through the same code.
Event.title: Event

EvidenceRow.description: One attempt as it bears on one skill: the provenance behind an estimate.
EvidenceRow.title: EvidenceRow

Export.description: Everything held about one learner (§17), and the estimates made from it, so a rebuild can be checked.
Export.title: Export

FirstAnswer.description: The first answer given: one option's id (a one-tap round), or where each piece was at the first check.
FirstAnswer.title: FirstAnswer

Hypothesis.description: A pattern seen, what could explain it, and what to try: never a label about the child.
Hypothesis.title: Hypothesis

KindRow.description: One kind of round as this learner has played it: how it went, how it was rated, how often picked.
KindRow.title: KindRow

Logged.description: A decision as stored and exported: the choice, where it was made and when, and for a choice what was picked.
Logged.title: Logged

MisconceptionReport.description: One misconception as the evidence stands, for a grown-up: a hypothesis with what it rests on.
MisconceptionReport.title: MisconceptionReport

Mode.description:
A kind of round: one template each, plus Mixed. The first five are the original rounds (their ids are kept, so
saved settings still name them).
Mode.title: Mode

Next.description:
`POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/next`: a round to play (`round`, checked, with its tries), an offered break, or the
end of the session, with the rationale codes, the same in words for a grown-up, and what else was weighed.
Next.title: Next

Offer.description: One of the two rounds a choice offers: enough to rebuild it, and why it was put forward.
Offer.title: Offer

OfferOut.description: One of a choice's two rounds, ready to play once picked, with its picture and name for the learner.
OfferOut.title: OfferOut

OverrideIn.description:
`POST /api/v1/learners/{id}/overrides`: a grown-up's observation of one skill (spec §15 "scoped human
observation"): the skill is its scope, `observer` its source label.
OverrideIn.title: OverrideIn

Profile.description: `GET /api/learners/{id}/profile`: the learner, what was recorded and every skill's estimates and state.
Profile.title: Profile

Rated.description: One rating, as the log keeps it and an export carries it.
Rated.title: Rated

RatingIn.description: `POST /api/attempts/{event_id}/rating`: how the learner said the round was, on three faces.
RatingIn.title: RatingIn

ReplayIn.description:
`POST /api/v1/evaluations/replay`: the policy to replay with (only the current one is kept) and the data, one of
a learner's records or a simulation.
ReplayIn.title: ReplayIn

SessionInfo.description: `POST /api/v1/sessions`: the session, the policy that will plan it and the settings it runs with.
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

Told.description: A grown-up's observation of one skill, as the log keeps it and an export carries it.
Told.title: Told

Transfer.description: A skill's transfer evidence, for the grown-up: the kind that checks it, and how it went there.
Transfer.title: Transfer

Why.description: Rationale codes (§15 "validated item + rationale codes"): what a decision is for.
Why.title: Why
